text:
No hiring option can be put forward from this run because the £400k annual-salary limit was not assessable.

- The comparison is **very fragile**: results depend on delivery capacity, onboarding load and salary spend. Onboarding load is an Olumi estimate; the approved starting values for delivery capacity and salary spend are user-adopted assumptions.
- The model also lacks a stated objective direction for “shipped by Q3”, so it used “higher” as an assumption rather than your confirmed success criterion.
- Crucially, salary spend is modelled as a change rather than a comparable £/year figure, so the strict constraint **annual salary spend < £400k/year** was left unscored—not treated as met.
